name: Road to De Other Side: a player knocked into the Embryo pit is lifted back when the boss dies
contract: Issue #10968: a player knocked off the Chimeric Embryo arena (map 937, arena middle 304.429, -206.081, 341.841) whose party then killed the boss was revived at the bottom of the pit with no way up. Expected: when the Chimeric Embryo (162716) dies, a player more than 15 yd below the arena and within 40 yd of its middle is resurrected if dead and put back on the arena.
